rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a day-5 expanded blastocyst and acknowledges limits of a single image, but it hedges against the reported 3BA and mentions irregular zona/collapse-like changes that may not be clearly supportable from the provided grading alone.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, PCOS, endometrium, sperm parameters, BMI, prior cycle history, and lifestyle factors well, though some links to embryo-specific prognosis are somewhat speculative.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a probability estimate that broadly follows from age and embryo quality; minor issues include speculative emphasis on natural-cycle/PCOS endocrine timing without supporting cycle data.

Mostly aligned on single embryo transfer, lifestyle optimization, and cautious use of PGT-A, but some statements about natural-cycle IVF in PCOS and progesterone-rise concerns are not clearly grounded in the provided case and are less guideline-based.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, lifestyle modification, luteal support review, and future-cycle workup; recommendations are useful though some are generic and not all are tightly tailored to available data.
